preconditions.description: The length of numbers a and b must be between 2 and 100,000.
Both numbers a and b must have the same number of digits and be within the valid range.
The lengths of the strings representing a and b must be equal.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not possible else str(c)
postconditions.description: If it is impossible to transform a into b, output -1; otherwise, output the minimal number of coins c.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= d_i <= n - 1 and s_i in {-1, 1} for d_i, s_i in moves)
postconditions.description: Each move must specify a valid position and a valid operation (either +1 or -1).
The number of moves output must not exceed 100,000.
